operations.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm exec rer install
operations.verify: pnpm exec rer check --profile first-party && pnpm run check:deployment-spec && pnpm run verify
operations.recovery: Follow OPERATIONS.md: pause writes and scheduled work, retain exact source and private configuration, export data before changing deployment, restore only into fresh empty resources, re-export and compare bytes, then verify owner sessions before routing traffic. Preserve every applied migration name and byte.
